B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA
  That the Planning Commission waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the
  agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have
  been read by title and further reading waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Rodriguez, seconded by Commissioner Roman, to
  adopt Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Roman, Winford, Hernandez, Navarro, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  017­012 CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS, CALIFORNIA; AND RECOMMENDING DENIAL OF
